cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take you for noodles. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's choosing people she sees every week. Pick our noodle place; I'll book.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. I'll buy dinner; you can complain about her all through it.

reason: Remove the self-explanation about the kindest accurate sentence; A instead offers concrete company that accepts B hurt while still giving only the edited version of the exclusion.
